# FG-REPO-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `path_segment_rules_match_adr_0015` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この名前は使えません。小文字の英数字と . _ - だけを、1〜64 文字で指定してください。
- en: This name cannot be used. Use 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
- id: Nama ini tidak dapat digunakan. Gunakan 1 sampai 64 huruf kecil, angka, '.', '_' atau '-'.

## 原因 (cause)

A user, group or project name (a namespace path segment) breaks the rules of ADR-0015: 1 to 64 characters matching ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9._-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?$, no '..', not ending in .git / .atom / .wiki, and not a Windows device name (con, prn, aux, nul, com1-9, lpt1-9), also not when only the part before the first dot is one.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (empty, too_long, charset, edge, double_dot, reserved_suffix, device_name; for a nested group or a project also too_deep, more than 20 levels, and path_too_long, a full path over 255 characters) and `len`; the name itself is not logged. The same rules are a CHECK of forge.namespaces.segment, so a name the parser accepts is never refused by the database.

## 対処 (fix)

Choose a name that follows the rules.
